title: A map of stalks of coherent modules comes from a map on a neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], $x\in X$, and $\psi:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules (stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]). Then there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $\varphi:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (restrictions $\mathcal F|_U(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ open) whose stalk map at $x$ is $\varphi_x=\psi$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y4 (label lemma-map-stalks-local-map); its proof: Lemma 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian) and Modules, Lemma stalk-internal-hom

proof.text: Since $X$ is locally Noetherian and $\mathcal G$ is coherent, $\mathcal G$ is finitely presented as an $\mathcal O_X$-module: by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] it is of finite type, and by coherence [pqf-def-coherent], after shrinking around $x$ a finite set of generating sections gives a surjection $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$ whose kernel is of finite type. Shrink once more and choose finitely many sections generating that kernel. Their map $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}$ has cokernel $\mathcal G|_V$, exactly a finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma Tag 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian), lines 2225-2270, equivalence of (1) and (3), invoked in proof of Lemma Tag 01Y4 (lemma-map-stalks-local-map), lines 2392-2407; local presentation expanded

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-internal-hom-finite-presentation] to the finitely presented source $\mathcal G$ (step 1) and target $\mathcal F$. It gives an isomorphism $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)_x\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal G_x,\mathcal F_x)$, so the given $\psi$ has a preimage $h$ in the internal-Hom stalk. By [def-pur-sheaf-hom], the sections of internal Hom over an open $U$ are precisely the $\mathcal O_U$-linear morphisms $\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$, and the stalk is their germs [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Thus $h$ has a representative $(U,\varphi)$ for some open $x\in U$, with $\varphi:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma Tag 01Y4 (lemma-map-stalks-local-map), lines 2403-2407, using Modules Lemma Tag 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom), lines 3619-3678

proof.text: The canonical map of step 2 sends the germ represented by $(U,\varphi)$ to $\varphi_x$ [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-internal-hom-finite-presentation]. Since it sends $h$ to $\psi$ by construction, $\varphi_x=\psi$. This $U$ and $\varphi$ give the required extension.
